## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user or contributor. Link the related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:public` passes.
- [ ] Relevant behavior was checked (include commands/results and UI evidence when useful).
- [ ] The changelog is updated for a user-visible or released-data change, or this is not applicable.
- [ ] Changed files contain only original or redistributable material; no paper PDFs, full-text extractions, source-page images, or source-bearing logs are included.

For corpus or model-note changes, record the exact candidate audit, benchmark review, promotion, and local `npm run check:research` results. For other changes, mark this paragraph not applicable. Public CI does not substitute for source-backed research validation.

## Limits or follow-up work

State any known uncertainty or remaining work. Cite papers by DOI/Atlas ID and page references; keep source files and rendered pages local.
